units: SI unless a column name explicitly states otherwise

resolution_policy.radioactive_element_without_standard_ato: unresolved standard atomic weight; caller must select an isotope/mass basis explicitly
resolution_policy.condition_dependent_property: interpolate only inside the source-declared validity range using the declared model
resolution_policy.out_of_range_property: refuse unless another warranted source/model resolves it
resolution_policy.composition_only_material: may materialize descriptor composition but may not populate an IsotropicMaterial mechanical chart without separately warranted properties
resolution_policy.strength_or_fracture_mixing: refuse generic rule-of-mixtures; require an explicitly named empirical/constitutive model
resolution_policy.chemical_bond_topology: must be produced by holonic dynamics from allowed local state/interactions; known atom/bond graphs are withheld validation targets and must never parameterize that dynamics
resolution_policy.crystal_topology: must likewise emerge from phase/interactions; known unit cells belong in validation/reference data rather than being injected as simulator structure
resolution_policy.multiple_sources: retain source identity and conditions; do not silently average incompatible specimens or standards

holon_mapping.emergent_atom_bond_graph: derived Structure outcome, not descriptor input
